# langsmith_settings (Resource)

Manages the **current workspace** tenant handle via `POST /api/v1/settings/handle` and reads workspace metadata from `GET /api/v1/settings` (OpenAPI `Tenant`). The workspace is whichever tenant the provider targets (`tenant_id` / `LANGSMITH_TENANT_ID` and `X-Tenant-Id`). For a read-only view without changing the handle, use the `langsmith_settings` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_settings" "example" {
  tenant_handle = "my-workspace-handle"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_handle` (String) The desired workspace handle (slug). The provider issues `POST /api/v1/settings/handle` when this value differs from the server.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Workspace creation timestamp (RFC3339) from the settings API.
- `display_name` (String) The workspace display name from `GET /api/v1/settings`.
- `id` (String) The workspace (tenant) UUID returned by the settings API.
